hpe_window_create.brief: 创建平台窗口并绑定回调 / Create a platform window and bind its callbacks

params.title: 窗口标题 / Window title
params.width: 客户区宽度（像素）/ Client width in pixels
params.height: 客户区高度（像素）/ Client height in pixels
params.callbacks: 窗口回调表，可为 NULL / Callback table, may be NULL
params.user: 透传给每个回调的用户数据 / User data passed through to every callback

hpe_window_create.return: 新窗口对象，失败返回 NULL / The new window object, NULL on failure
hpe_window_create.note: 窗口是运行期间唯一的顶层窗口；调用方随后需 `hpe_window_destroy` / The window is the single top-level window for the run; the caller later calls `hpe_window_destroy`

hpe_window_present.brief: 提交一帧 BGRA 像素并请求重绘 / Present one BGRA frame and request a repaint

params.bgra_pixels: BGRA32 像素数据 / BGRA32 pixel data
params.stride_bytes: 每行字节数 / Bytes per row

hpe_window_present.note: 缓冲需在窗口下次重绘前保持有效 / The buffer must stay valid until the window repaints

hpe_window_set_title.brief: 设置窗口标题栏文本 / Set the window caption text

params.title: 新的标题文本（UTF-8）/ New caption text in UTF-8

hpe_window_invalidate.brief: 请求重绘整个客户区 / Request a repaint of the whole client area

hpe_window_request_close.brief: 异步请求关闭窗口 / Ask the window to close asynchronously

hpe_window_run.brief: 进入消息循环直到窗口关闭 / Run the message loop until the window closes
hpe_window_run.return: 进程退出码 / The process exit code
hpe_window_run.note: 阻塞调用，窗口关闭后返回 / Blocks and returns once the window closes

hpe_window_destroy.brief: 销毁窗口并释放窗口对象 / Destroy the window and free the window object

hpe_time_seconds.brief: 读取单调时钟秒数 / Read monotonic seconds
hpe_time_seconds.return: 自某个未指定起点起的单调秒数 / Monotonic seconds since an unspecified origin

hpe_time_epoch_ms.brief: 读取自 Unix 纪元起的 UTC 墙钟毫秒 / Read UTC wall-clock milliseconds since the Unix epoch
hpe_time_epoch_ms.return: 自 1970-01-01 UTC 起的毫秒数 / Milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC

hpe_read_file.brief: 读取整个文件到新分配的缓冲 / Read a whole file into a freshly allocated buffer

params.out_size: out:接收读入的字节数，可为 NULL / Receives the byte count read, may be NULL

hpe_read_file.return: 以 NUL 结尾的内容缓冲，失败返回 NULL / NUL-terminated contents buffer, NULL on failure
hpe_read_file.note: 调用方需用 `hpe_free` 释放 / The caller must `hpe_free` the result

hpe_path_dir.brief: 取出路径的目录部分 / Take the directory part of a path

params.out: out:接收目录的缓冲 / Receives the directory
params.out_size: 接收缓冲区容量 / Capacity of the output buffer

hpe_path_is_absolute.brief: 判断路径是否为绝对路径 / Test whether a path is absolute

params.path: 待检查路径 / Path to check

hpe_path_is_absolute.return: 绝对路径返回 1，否则 0 / 1 for an absolute path, 0 otherwise

hpe_path_join.brief: 把相对路径接到目录上 / Join a relative path onto a directory

params.out: out:接收拼接结果的缓冲 / Receives the joined path
params.out_size: 接收缓冲区容量 / Capacity of the output buffer

hpe_path_absolute.brief: 把路径解析为绝对路径 / Resolve a path to an absolute one

params.out: out:接收绝对路径的缓冲 / Receives the absolute path
params.out_size: 接收缓冲区容量 / Capacity of the output buffer

hpe_path_absolute.note: 相对进程工作目录解析；失败时原样拷回，供地址栏显示绝对文件路径 / Resolves against the process working directory; copies the input through unchanged on failure, as the address bar shows absolute file paths

hpe_clipboard_get_text.brief: 取剪贴板文本或首个文件路径 / Read clipboard text or the first file path
hpe_clipboard_get_text.return: 以 UTF-8 编码的剪贴板内容（需 `hpe_free`），无文本时返回 NULL / UTF-8 clipboard contents (needs `hpe_free`), NULL when there is no text
hpe_clipboard_get_text.note: 资源管理器复制的文件以首个文件路径的形式暴露，符合地址栏用户的预期 / Files copied in Explorer are exposed as the first file's path, which is what an address bar user expects

hpe_clipboard_set_text.brief: 用 UTF-8 文本替换剪贴板内容 / Replace the clipboard contents with UTF-8 text

params.utf8: 待写入的 UTF-8 文本 / UTF-8 text to write

hpe_clipboard_set_text.return: 成功返回 1，失败返回 0 / 1 on success, 0 on failure
hpe_clipboard_set_text.note: 失败时为无操作 / A no-op on failure

hpe_plat_font_create.brief: 创建平台字体对象 / Create a platform font object

params.pixel_size: 字号（像素）/ Font size in pixels

hpe_plat_font_create.return: 新字体对象，失败返回 NULL / The new font object, NULL on failure

hpe_plat_font_destroy.brief: 销毁字体对象并释放其资源 / Destroy a font object and release its resources

params.font: 待销毁的字体 / Font to destroy

hpe_plat_font_ascent.brief: 取字体的上伸部 / Get the font ascent
hpe_plat_font_ascent.return: 上伸部像素数 / Ascent in pixels

hpe_plat_font_descent.brief: 取字体的下伸部 / Get the font descent
hpe_plat_font_descent.return: 下伸部像素数 / Descent in pixels

hpe_plat_font_line_height.brief: 取字体的行高 / Get the font line height
hpe_plat_font_line_height.return: 行高像素数 / Line height in pixels

hpe_plat_font_advance.brief: 取单个码点的步进宽度 / Measure the advance width of a single code point

params.codepoint: Unicode 码点 / Unicode code point

hpe_plat_font_advance.return: 步进宽度（像素）/ Advance width in pixels

hpe_plat_font_mask.brief: 把 UTF-8 文本渲染成 8 位覆盖率掩码 / Render a UTF-8 run into an 8-bit coverage mask

params.utf8: 待渲染的 UTF-8 文本 / UTF-8 text to render
params.len: 文本字节数 / Number of bytes
params.out: out:接收掩码的结构 / Struct that receives the mask

hpe_plat_font_mask.return: 成功返回 1，失败返回 0 / 1 on success, 0 on failure
hpe_plat_font_mask.note: 覆盖区相对基线：x 从 0 起，y 在 `[-descent, ascent)`；`baseline` 为基线所在行索引 / Coverage is relative to the baseline: x from 0 and y over `[-descent, ascent)`; `baseline` is the row index of the baseline

hpe_text_mask_free.brief: 释放文本掩码 / Free a text mask

params.mask: 待释放的掩码 / Mask to free
